Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +3 and ATK & DEF 170%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Medium chance of evading enemy's attack
- Damage reduction rate 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Randomly changes Ki Spheres of a certain Type to Rainbow Ki Spheres
- "Androids" Category allies' ATK & DEF 70%{passiveImg:up_g}
*Per "Defenders of Justice" or "Androids" Category ally on the team
(depending on which Category has more members)*
- Chance of evading enemy's attack & damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
(up to 40%)
*When there is another "Defenders of Justice" or "Androids" Category
ally on the team*
- ATK 170%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- Foresees enemy's Super Attack when HP is 70% or more
- {passiveImg:once}Evades enemy's attack as the 1st attacker in a turn
*When attacking*
- ATK & DEF 170%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every attack received or evaded*
- {passiveImg:forever}ATK 50%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 200%)
- {passiveImg:forever}Chance of performing a critical hit 20%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 100%)
